title: Scientists Drilled 12 Kilometres Down. It Hit 180 Degrees

scenes.text: Scientists drilled 12 kilometres into the Earth.
It is the Kola borehole in Russia, started in 1970.
It reached 12,262 metres, but the hole is only nine inches wide.
At the bottom it was 180 degrees Celsius, nearly twice what they predicted.
The rock turned soft, and the drills started to warp.
They had gone only about a third of the way through the crust.

description:
The Kola Superdeep Borehole in Russia reached 12,262 metres, the deepest hole ever drilled.
It hit about 180 degrees Celsius, nearly twice the prediction, and drilling stopped.
What do you think is down there?
first_comment: Would you go down a hole 12 kilometres deep if you could?
